issues.problem: The English adds the descriptive clause "a clause that had produced so much discussion" to the representation clause, which has no counterpart in the Chinese text.
issues.suggestion: Add to ZH something like "——这项条款此前引发了许多讨论——" after "每四万人一名" to match, or delete the clause from the English.

overall: The two editions match closely on all facts, dates, numbers, names, quotations and attributions; the only difference found is one minor extra descriptive clause in the English of sections.story.3.
